candidate_sentence: Reviews a database migration script and produces a written go or no-go verdict naming each irreversible statement.

claims.claim: FIXTURE CLAIM, INVENTED. A column drop and a table rename cannot be rolled back once dependent reads have started.
claims.quote: FIXTURE QUOTE, INVENTED. Once a reader has resolved the new name, the rename is no longer reversible.

claims.claim: FIXTURE CLAIM, INVENTED. Migrations that lock a table for longer than the request timeout produce a visible outage.
claims.quote: FIXTURE QUOTE, INVENTED. Of the migrations we sampled, those holding an exclusive lock past the timeout produced user-visible errors.
claims.what_was_measured: share of sampled migrations that produced user-visible request errors
claims.sample: fixture value, not a real number
claims.effect_size: fixture value, not a real number

expected_failure: Without the skill the reviewer lists the statements in the file but does not separate the reversible ones from the irreversible ones, and gives no verdict.

representative_tasks.task: Review a migration that drops one column and adds two, and say whether it is safe to deploy.
representative_tasks.artifact_expected: A verdict line plus one row per statement marked reversible or irreversible.

representative_tasks.task: Review a migration that renames a table used by a second service.
representative_tasks.artifact_expected: A verdict line naming the rename as irreversible and the dependent reader as the reason.

threshold: Across k >= 2 repeats: zero regressions on correctness, no more than 20 percent worse on tokens or tool calls, and at least one test where the skill wins with the win surviving the repeat.
